name: Taking Care Of Yourself
overview: Scripture reveals that our bodies are fearfully and wonderfully made by God from the very beginning, as seen in Psalms 139:13. Taking care of ourselves is an act of worship, presenting our bodies as living sacrifices holy and pleasing to God, according to Romans 12:1. Moreover, the strength to maintain this stewardship comes through Christ, who empowers us in all things, as affirmed in Philippians 4:13. This care is rooted in our identity as servants of Christ, who has revealed His will to guide and sustain us, exemplified in Revelation 1:1.
